rules.title: Pending servicing transaction detected
rules.probable_cause: Windows has an incomplete servicing transaction that may prevent normal boot.
rules.recommendation: Correlate CBS, DISM and Panther evidence before applying a servicing rollback.

rules.title: EFI present but BCD unreadable
rules.probable_cause: The EFI System Partition is present but the Windows Boot Configuration Data store cannot be read.
rules.recommendation: Back up the EFI boot files and rebuild Windows boot files using the audited BCDBoot repair action.
